statement.zh: **事件**：格罗弗算法提出（Grover's Algorithm）。arXiv 记录的标题是「A fast quantum mechanical algorithm for database search」，摘要用电话簿为例：「Imagine a phone directory containing N names arranged in completely random order.In order to find someone's phone number with a 50% probability, any classical algorithm (whether deterministic or probabilistic) will need to look at a minimum of N/2 names」，而量子方案「the desired phone number can be obtained in only O(sqrt(N)) steps」。
statement.en: **Event**: Grover's Algorithm.It is registered under cryptanalysis, quantum cryptography, dated 1996.

statement.zh: 摘要对自身最优性的表述是相对的：「The algorithm is within a small constant factor of the fastest possible quantum mechanical algorithm」——即与最快的量子算法至多差一个小常数因子，而不是无条件的绝对最优声明。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in cryptanalysis, quantum cryptography, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 该文首次发表于理论计算机会议：期刊引用为「Proceedings, 28th Annual ACM Symposium on the Theory of Computing (STOC), May 1996, pages 212-219」，评论字段亦说明「This is an updated version of a paper that was originally presented at STOC 1996.The algorithm is the same; however, the proof has been simplified by using a new interpretation」，该解释在原文中被称作「inversion about average」。
